title: Fix equipa main.mo: add HashMap import and use Time.now() for timestamps

requirements.text: In backend/main.mo (the equipa canister), add the missing import statement `import HashMap "mo:base/HashMap";` so the canister compiles without the 'unbound variable HashMap' error at line 47.

quotes: provide the full corrected main.mo with the HashMap import

acceptanceCriteria: The import `import HashMap "mo:base/HashMap";` is present at the top of main.mo alongside other imports
Running `dfx deploy equipa` completes without the 'unbound variable HashMap' type error
All existing HashMap usages in the file resolve correctly

requirements.text: In backend/main.mo, fix all places where device records are constructed with `timestamp = 0` by replacing the hardcoded `0` with `Time.now()`. Add `import Time "mo:base/Time";` if not already present.

quotes: fix the timestamp = 0 issue by adding Time.now()

acceptanceCriteria: The import `import Time "mo:base/Time";` is present in main.mo
Every location that previously assigned `timestamp = 0` now assigns `timestamp = Time.now()`
Querying any registered device (e.g., shelly-1) returns a record where `timestamp` is a non-zero integer reflecting the current IC time
The canister deploys and runs without compilation errors

constraints: Only modify backend/main.mo — do not change any frontend files
Do not alter the existing data model, Candid interface, or any stable variable declarations beyond what is required for these two fixes
Do not introduce new dependencies beyond mo:base/HashMap and mo:base/Time
nonGoals: Fixing the mock device data values (power=1250.0, voltage=240.0, current=5.2, carbon=0.85) — real Shelly HTTP response parsing is out of scope for this request
